_comment: Companies of the 'What Companies Report' section of the American Consumer page. The release harvester resolves each ticker's CIK from the SEC's own ticker file and stores the exhibits of the latest results 8-K (Item 2.02) as text; the curated figures and quotes in data/companies-kpis.json are checked against that text. `annual` / `quarterly` (optional): a pattern; the passages of the latest Form 10-K / 10-Q that match it are stored too (workers and their earnings are stated yearly; revenue by country is in the quarterly report's notes). `curated: false`: releases are stored but no figure is on the page yet.
